# KTX2 test fixture attribution

`2d_etc1s.ktx2` is an unmodified sample from the [KTX2-Samples project](https://github.com/donmccurdy/KTX2-Samples), maintained by Don McCurdy. The upstream project publishes its samples under [Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-SA 4.0)](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/).

Source file: <https://github.com/donmccurdy/KTX2-Samples/blob/main/ktx2/2d_etc1s.ktx2>

No changes have been made to the fixture. It is included solely to exercise the real Basis Universal transcoder in the Phase 15 test suite.

- `triangle.glb` is a tiny original Phase 9.1 test fixture generated from one triangle; it contains no third-party assets or dependencies.
